sourceModel.description: The flight-control law, ground contact geometry and aerodynamic coefficient tables are derived from the upstream JSBSim F-16A baseline.

derivations.method: first-order scale of the upstream F-16 baseline by public empty-mass, span and length ratios
unit conversion from the midpoints of the published EJ200 specific-fuel-consumption ranges

knownLimitations: Aerodynamic coefficient tables are inherited from the F-16 baseline and are not Eurofighter-specific.
The flight-control law is a generic fighter fly-by-wire baseline, not the Typhoon control law.
Landing-gear positions and external-store modelling remain inherited or unsupported.
This model is not certified, validated or representative of classified aircraft data.

validationReferences.name: Eurofighter Typhoon Performance
validationReferences.use: published thrust, speed, altitude, length and span

validationReferences.name: EJ200 Product Information
validationReferences.use: public engine thrust, bypass ratio and fuel-consumption ranges

validationReferences.name: CJ Simulations Eurofighter Typhoon Manual
validationReferences.use: open secondary reference for wing area, baseline empty mass and internal fuel capacity

validationReferences.name: FGAddon Eurofighter YASim
validationReferences.use: GPL reference for qualitative validation only; no XML parameters are copied into this package
